{{Quote|Sumar to Captain Syndor. There has been an incident with Commander Faal. All brain activity has ceased. You are once again commander of the ''Winged Dagger''. Congratulations, Commander.|Sumar, contacting Syndor after Faal's death|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Sumar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. In [[44 ABY]], she served aboard the [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Winged Dagger]]'' under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Syndor]]. Syndor was replaced by [[Leeha Faal]], however, at the orders of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]]. Later, during their [[mission to the Maw]], Sumar was appointed to attend to Faal's body while Faal [[Mind Walking|Mind Walked]] [[beyond shadows]]. However, while there, Faal was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and her body spasmed and her brain activity flatlined. Sumar instantly contacted Syndor and informed him of her death, giving him back command of the ''Winged Dagger''.
